environment.agent: Codex; model identity GPT-6 per runtime instructions, exact build not exposed; inherited configuration
environment.isolation: 12 new task threads, fork_turns=none, skill-only snapshot excludes README/examples/tests/rubrics; one owner per case; shared filesystem, workers instructed not to read other outputs
environment.reviewer: Root maintainer; saw rubrics, not independent/blinded evaluator
environment.browser: No artifact browser checks. Cloud file URL blocked; no workaround used. No Chromium/Playwright browser launched.

method: One skill-loaded attempt per case; seven implementations inspected, five written reviews examined; 33 root-run jsdom checks. No baseline, repeated sampling, cross-model or representative-user test.

scenarios.reason: Created an aligned incident table with source-appropriate severity/owner/age hierarchy, truthful local scope, filters, claim/release and empty recovery. Five jsdom checks passed. Rendered hierarchy, actual pointer/keyboard interaction, targets and narrow layout remain untested.
